title: biomes.ground/1
description: data/biomes/ground.json: planet generation 2's ground profiles (docs/world/planet-gen2.md, window 2; WorldGround): what each fine biome does to a body and what stands on it. Version field: schema. Policy: every key required, objects closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-checks (a profile for each of climate.json's fine biomes, in its order, by name; canopy cover needs trees) are WorldGround's own load and ground_check.

minGround.description: Trees stand only where the ground is at least this high, in units (sea level is 0).

provisionalProps.description: Lay the props rows marked provisional (World's sizes until Art sets them). Off by default: propsIn lays what it laid before.

id.description: The fine biome's id: its index in climate.json's fine list.

name.description: The fine biome's name: must be climate.json's fine[id].name (checked on load).

surface.description: The contact class on this ground (contact.json surfaces); the renderer's effects and Audio know these.

look.description: The look class of this ground: the five built (paving, rock, soil, sand, rubble) or the nine of Combat's biome park (ice, snow, frost, mud, turf, litter, ash, crust, shingle).

grip.description: Multiplier on the surface's braking: more is mud, less is ice.

absorb.description: Multiplier on the bounce's vertical keep: soft ground eats a bounce.

rough.description: Multiplier, at least 1, on the braking of stones, roots and rubble: a skid on rough ground is shortened and never lengthened, and never becomes a tumble.

furrow.description: Multiplier on the trench a skid cuts and the berm it heaps.

gap.description: The gap between trees, [low, high], in feature units (WS).

h.description: A tree's height, [low, high], in feature units (WS).

trees.description: What grows here, or null for nothing.

kind.description: canopy needs a tree near; ridge is rock.

low.description: How far above the ground a fighter finds the hiding, in feature units (WS).

cover.description: Where a fighter hides on this ground, or null for nowhere.

per.description: How many to every 1,000 units of ground.

size.description: Size, [low, high], as multiples of the prop's own size.

gap.description: A lone tree's clear ground from any other tree, [low, high], in feature units (WS); for W5's placement.

provisional.description: World's own row until Art sets its sizes: laid only with provisionalProps on.

grounds.description: One profile for each fine biome of climate.json, in its order.
